description: Tests whether the API documentation link on the main page redirects the user to the correct external API documentation URL.
steps: Locate the API documentation link with the 'roost-icon' class.
Verify that the user is redirected to https://docs.roost.ai.
Ensure the content of the external API documentation is loaded correctly.
expected_results: Clicking the link redirects the user to https://docs.roost.ai.
The external API documentation content is visible and functional.
edge_cases: The external API documentation page is unavailable.
The link is disabled or broken.
The external page takes too long to load.
The external content is unavailable or incomplete.
data_requirements: A valid external API documentation URL.
Network connectivity to access the external page.
Functional redirection link from the main page.
dependencies: The external API documentation page is live.
The redirection link is configured correctly.
accessibility_requirements: Link has a descriptive accessible name or aria-label.
Accessible navigation on the external page.
